body:
**Mondo term (ID and Label)**
MONDO:0023124 familial pulmonary arterial hypertension leucopenia and atrial septal defect

**Reason for deprecation**
The only "class info" or anything resembling an x-ref is a non-existent GARD link- https://rarediseases.info.nih.gov/diseases/10455/familial-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension-leucopenia-and-atrial-septal-defect

**Suggested term to consider**
None.

**Your nano-attribution (ORCID)**
If you don't have an ORCID, you can sign up for one [here](https://orcid.org/)

comments.body:
@MeeSiing I agree with the proposal to rename MONDO:0023124 as Dursen syndrome. X-ref to OMIM 612541 is also appropriate, but it should get looped into the "OMIM included" ticket (see https://github.com/monarch-initiative/mondo/issues/5507) and tagging, whenever that can be addressed.
If adding ORPHA:178503, will it be flagged as an obsolete ID from Orphanet? I see it is showing in ORDO under "depracated disorder."
@kanems, you are right. OMIM 612541 will be MONDO:includedEntryInOMIM and ORPHA:178503 will be MONDO:equivalentObsolete in Mondo.

title: [Obsolete]MONDO:0023124 familial pulmonary arterial hypertension leucopenia and atrial septal defect
